rule: Every brew is a bet. A tonic has a base effect that always lands and a JACKPOT effect that lands with probability p. Combining two herbs multiplies their odds (parlay): p = pA * pB, but the jackpot payout scales by 1/p (fair odds, no house edge). Brewing in a storm (Sky Director weather Storm) multiplies p by 1.2 (cap 0.95; Parlayvine fixed at 1.0) while the payout stays at 1/p_base, so every herb gets the same +20% EV edge in a storm: the Reaper favors the bold, evenly. Stormbloom may re-roll a failed jackpot once; its payout is 1/p_eff with p_eff = 1-(1-p)^2, so the re-roll stays fair.

herbs.note: the safe bet; lowers parlay variance

herbs.jackpot: see the next drop/craft outcome before committing

water: Every tonic brew consumes 0.5 L water. Spring water: normal. Storm-cistern water brewed during Rain/Storm: jackpot p x1.05 (stacks with the storm x1.2, cap 0.95). Herb plants need 1 L/day or pause growth.
